text:
tess_pm: RCA published for the early-morning fallback routing incident — link: https://redwood.internal/rcas/2471234567-fallback-tokenizer-mismatch

raja_eng: TL;DR — during a partial capacity failure, router promoted a fallback model that used an older tokenizer format, causing malformed tokens and a ~6% error rate for ~8m on a subset of routes. No PII exposure.

emma_sre: Confirmed root cause: fallback selection logic didn't validate tokenizer compatibility metadata. We only checked architecture/size.

luke_ops: Impact: some paid routes returned truncated or garbage responses; customers may have seen degraded outputs. CS notified and monitoring ticket created.

rca-bot: RCA document published by tess_pm — https://redwood.internal/rcas/2471234567-fallback-tokenizer-mismatch

tess_pm: Action items (owners + short ETAs):
• eng: add tokenizer-compatibility check in router selection + unit tests (raja_eng) — ETA 48h
• sre: alert for fallback_incompatible_tokenizer > 0 for 2m and add runbook (emma_sre) — ETA 24h
• ops: augment canary to include tokenizer sanity probe and run targeted canary for affected routes (luke_ops) — ETA 24–48h
• docs: update deployment playbook to require explicit tokenizer metadata for all variants (tess_pm) — ETA 7d

raja_eng: ack — will open PR: https://git.redwood/internal/router/pull/589 that includes compat checks and a small harness test. Also adding a warning to the router logs when fallback chosen.

emma_sre: I'll add the alert rule and a short playbook for on-call mitigations (rollback to compatible fallback) and attach it to the RCA.

luke_ops: will add the tokenizer probe to canary pipeline and run a focused canary in staging tonight. Will paste dashboard snapshots in the doc.

tess_pm: Scheduling checkpoints: 48h quick sync (everyone) and 14-day closure with verification steps. Please add PR/links & status in the RCA under 'owners & status'.

raja_eng: reproduction steps added to RCA under 'how to repro'. Minimal repro command: 
```
# reproduce tokenizer mismatch locally
python tools/simulate_fallback.py --fallback-tokenizer=legacy --traffic=500
```

emma_sre: added runbook snippet and a temporary alert that fires to a private channel while we validate.

luke_ops: CS draft added to RCA's 'external comms' section. DO NOT SEND until product approves.

tess_pm: thanks — setting comms-hold until product ok. If any owners are blocked, DM me. We'll reconvene at the 48h sync. :wave:
